title: The Imaginary World of Sovereign Citizens
summary: A police officer explains free-inhabitant and Articles of Confederation claims and how traffic stops with sovereign citizens end in removal and charges.

assertions.quote: we don't follow the articles of confederation anymore we follow the united states constitution
if you do not i am going to remove you from the vehicle forcibly and i am going to charge you with obstruction
if they continue to refuse then it's go time
it's an excuse to not get a driver's license or to pay to have license plates on your car
